Not for students who have taken LAWS2101 & LAWS2102 Enrollment Requirements Class Attributes English only Class Availability Class Capacity 65 Wait List Capacity 999 Enrollment Total 65 Wait List Total 6 Available Seats 0 Description This course is designed to acquaint students with the principles of modern company law in Hong Kong and to increase their awareness of the legal issues which are of interest to the commercial community. It will examine the formation of companies, the effects of incorporation, the division of powers as between the various organs of the company, its relationship with outsiders, key differences in methods of fund raising, options available to companies in financial difficulties and the role of external regulatory bodies.
